content.user_title: Plan a Full-Page Capture Chrome Extension
content.value_statement: Full-page browser captures require careful scrolling, image stitching, and export planning. This public guide outlines a Manifest V3 approach, but does not include extension source.
actual_capabilities: Outlines a scrolling capture workflow involving page segments and image stitching.
Identifies offscreen documents and background workers as Manifest V3 architecture components.
Describes intended PNG download, local PDF generation, and clipboard export options.
Explains the intended vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS development approach.
Lists browser memory and sticky header limitations and describes loading an unpacked extension.
limitations: Only SKILL.md is included; extension source, scripts, and templates are absent.
Production readiness, capture accuracy, and Manifest V3 compliance cannot be verified without the implementation.
The guide excludes React and Vue build workflows.
The described approach may encounter browser memory limits on long pages and problems with sticky or fixed headers.

use_cases.title: Plan a Capture Extension
use_cases.description: Use the guide to scope scrolling, stitching, and local export requirements before implementing a Chrome extension.

use_cases.title: Review Manifest V3 Concepts
use_cases.description: Identify the roles of background workers and offscreen documents in the described image processing architecture.

use_cases.title: Prepare Capture Acceptance Tests
use_cases.description: Turn the documented lazy-loading, sticky header, export, and memory concerns into acceptance criteria for a separately implemented extension.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the capture workflow described in this guide. Separate documented concepts from implementation files that are not included.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this guide, propose a vanilla JavaScript Manifest V3 architecture for scrolling captures and local exports. Label implementation details absent from the guide.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Acceptance Criteria
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft acceptance criteria for a separately implemented extension covering lazy loading, sticky headers, long pages, PNG downloads, and local PDF export.

prompt_templates.title: Assess an Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare extension source I provide separately against this guide. Assess capture accuracy, minimal permissions, local processing, and Manifest V3 compatibility without assuming compliance.

output_examples.input: What does this package provide for building a capture extension?
output: Included: a public guide describing scrolling captures, viewport stitching, and local exports.
Architecture concepts: Manifest V3 background workers and offscreen documents.
Not included: extension source, scripts, or templates.

output_examples.input: Which scenarios should a separately implemented extension be tested against?
output: Lazy-loaded content: confirm all intended content appears before capture.
Sticky headers: check for repeated or misplaced elements in stitched images.
Long pages: check memory usage and graceful failure.
Exports: verify PNG and PDF output using the actual implementation.

best_practices: Confirm that extension source is available separately before planning installation or runtime testing.
Use explicit user activation, minimal browser permissions, and local processing when implementing the described workflow.
Test lazy-loaded pages, fixed headers, and long documents before relying on capture results.
anti_patterns: Treating documentation claims as proof that executable source or a production-ready extension is included.
Assuming screenshots or PDF files can be generated by this guide alone.
Assuming compatibility, capture accuracy, or memory behavior without testing an actual implementation.

faq.question: Does this package contain a working extension?
faq.answer: No. The supplied package contains only SKILL.md and explicitly excludes extension source, scripts, and templates.

faq.question: Can this skill capture pages or generate PDFs directly?
faq.answer: No. It describes those features, but executable capture and export components are not included.

faq.question: Which architecture does the guide describe?
faq.answer: It describes Chrome Manifest V3, background workers, offscreen documents, and vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

faq.question: Does the guide require external PDF services?
faq.answer: The described design uses local PDF generation without external APIs. No implementation is included to verify that behavior.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: You can ask these assistants to analyze the guide or plan an implementation. Reviewing an actual extension requires source supplied separately.

faq.question: What limitations should I plan for?
faq.answer: The guide warns about browser memory on long pages and sticky or fixed headers. It also excludes React and Vue build workflows.
